#!/bin/bash
# autoware_carla_scenario: one task of a batch submitted with launcher=slurm (docs/slurm.md).
# Batch: /work/outputs/2026-10-19/12-00-00  submission: 0
set -u
TASK="${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID:?this script runs as a SLURM array task}"

# The submitting shell's environment, as it was (launcher.env_passthrough).

# CARLA renders off-screen (launcher.headless).
unset DISPLAY WAYLAND_DISPLAY

cd /work || exit 1
PORT_FILE=/work/outputs/2026-10-19/12-00-00/slurm/tasks/0-${TASK}.port

# The worker runs in the background so that the signal SLURM sends
# before the time limit (--signal=B:TERM) reaches it through this trap.
/usr/bin/python3 -u -m autoware_carla_scenario.slurm.worker /work/outputs/2026-10-19/12-00-00/slurm/manifest.json 0 "$TASK" &
child=$!
trap 'kill -TERM "$child" 2>/dev/null' TERM INT USR1 USR2
rc=0
while :; do
  wait "$child"; rc=$?
  kill -0 "$child" 2>/dev/null || break
done

# The worker stops its CARLA however it ends, and removes the port file
# once it has; if it was killed outright, its CARLA is stopped here.
if [ -s "$PORT_FILE" ]; then
  port=$(cat "$PORT_FILE")
  if pkill -TERM -f -- "-carla-rpc-port=${port}( |$)"; then
    sleep 5
    pkill -KILL -f -- "-carla-rpc-port=${port}( |$)"
  fi
  rm -f "$PORT_FILE"
fi
exit "$rc"

#!/bin/bash
# autoware_carla_scenario: collects a batch submitted with launcher=slurm once its array has ended (docs/slurm.md).
# Batch: o/d/t under launcher.remote_cwd /scratch/alice
set -u

# launcher.remote_cwd: the submit host sees this file system at other
# paths, so every path here is the node's.  The job user's home on
# this node, from its passwd database: --export may have handed over
# the submit host's $HOME.
node_home=$(getent passwd "$(id -u)" 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f6)
if [ -n "$node_home" ]; then export HOME="$node_home"; fi
cd /scratch/alice || { echo "launcher.remote_cwd: no directory "/scratch/alice >&2; exit 1; }
WORKDIR=$PWD
BATCH_DIR="$WORKDIR"/o/d/t
# The job's output from here on: the batch's logs.
exec >>"$BATCH_DIR"/slurm/logs/"collect-${SLURM_JOB_ID}.out" 2>&1

cd "$WORKDIR" || exit 1
exec python3 -m autoware_carla_scenario.slurm.cli collect "$BATCH_DIR"

# Batch: o/d/t under launcher.remote_cwd ~  submission: 0
set -u
TASK="${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID:?this script runs as a SLURM array task}"

# launcher.remote_cwd: the submit host sees this file system at other
# paths, so every path here is the node's.  The job user's home on
# this node, from its passwd database: --export may have handed over
# the submit host's $HOME.
node_home=$(getent passwd "$(id -u)" 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f6)
if [ -n "$node_home" ]; then export HOME="$node_home"; fi
cd "$HOME" || { echo "launcher.remote_cwd: no directory ""$HOME" >&2; exit 1; }
WORKDIR=$PWD
BATCH_DIR="$WORKDIR"/o/d/t
# The job's output from here on: the batch's logs.
exec >>"$BATCH_DIR"/slurm/logs/"${SLURM_ARRAY_JOB_ID}_${TASK}.out" 2>&1

# The submitting shell's environment, as it was (launcher.env_passthrough).
export PATH=/bin

# CARLA renders off-screen (launcher.headless).
unset DISPLAY WAYLAND_DISPLAY

cd "$WORKDIR" || exit 1
PORT_FILE="$BATCH_DIR"/slurm/tasks/0-${TASK}.port

# The worker runs in the background so that the signal SLURM sends
# before the time limit (--signal=B:TERM) reaches it through this trap.
"$HOME"/bin/python -u -m autoware_carla_scenario.slurm.worker "$BATCH_DIR"/slurm/manifest.json 0 "$TASK" &
child=$!
trap 'kill -TERM "$child" 2>/dev/null' TERM INT USR1 USR2
rc=0
while :; do
  wait "$child"; rc=$?
  kill -0 "$child" 2>/dev/null || break
done

# The worker stops its CARLA however it ends, and removes the port file
# once it has; if it was killed outright, its CARLA is stopped here.
if [ -s "$PORT_FILE" ]; then
  port=$(cat "$PORT_FILE")
  if pkill -TERM -f -- "-carla-rpc-port=${port}( |$)"; then
    sleep 5
    pkill -KILL -f -- "-carla-rpc-port=${port}( |$)"
  fi
  rm -f "$PORT_FILE"
fi
exit "$rc"
